# hg prompt

**What this page tells you:** every `hg prompt` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Send one prompt to a deployed agent.

## Synopsis

```text
hg prompt "<text>" [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--timeout` | `<seconds>` | `300` | How long to wait for the reply. |
